title: A Multimodal Recaptioning Framework to Account for Perceptual Diversity Across Languages in Vision-Language Modeling

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating image-text retrieval performance (mean recall) on native speaker datasets (e.g., Japanese STAIR, German Multi30k) compared to models trained on machine-translated English text. The authors construct 'Native vs. Translation Error Sets' to isolate culture-specific perceptual differences and use WordNet synset mappings to calculate and compare object term frequency distributions across languages.
